books.title: Barchester Towers
books.author: Anthony Trollope
books.summary: The affections of a young widow are at play while rival clerical factions contend for control over church matters in the cathedral city of Barchester.

books.title: The Three Musketeers
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.summary: A young Gascon moves to Paris to join the King’s Musketeers where he starts to investigate the kidnapping of his landlord’s wife.

books.title: A Daughter of the Samurai
books.author: Etsu Inagaki Sugimoto
books.summary: The autobiography of Etsu Sugimoto, a girl born into a samurai family in a time of great cultural changes.

books.title: Queen Victoria
books.author: Lytton Strachey
books.summary: A sardonic and generally unflattering biography of Victoria Alexandrina, Queen of England.

books.title: The Blue Bird
books.author: Maurice Maeterlinck
books.summary: Two children go on a magical adventure in search of the Blue Bird.

books.title: Jurgen
books.author: James Branch Cabell
books.summary: Jurgen, a pawnbroker and “monstrous clever fellow,” is sent on a witty and parodic magical journey in search of true love.

books.title: The Hairy Ape
books.author: Eugene O’Neill
books.summary: An expressionist play following a brutish stoker’s dehumanization as he descends from being a leader of his fellow workers to a literal ape.

books.title: Darby O’Gill and the Good People
books.author: Herminie Templeton Kavanagh
books.summary: When Tipperary man Darby O’Gill is imprisoned by the fairies of Sleive-na-mon in their home under the hollow mountain, he starts a lasting friendship with their King Brian Connors.

books.title: The Circular Staircase
books.author: Mary Roberts Rinehart
books.summary: A middle-aged spinster rents a country home for the summer and finds herself in the middle of a murder mystery.

books.title: The Necromancers
books.author: Robert Hugh Benson
books.summary: A young woman watches with concern as her adopted brother turns to irreligious forces in the hopes of reconnecting with his dead fiancée.

books.title: Sailing Alone Around the World
books.author: Joshua Slocum
books.summary: A sailor gives his account how he completed the first solo sailing voyage around the world.

books.title: Mystery at Lynden Sands
books.author: J. J. Connington
books.summary: A Chief Constable’s holiday on the coast is interrupted when he is drawn into investigating a murder.

books.title: The Origin of Species
books.author: Charles Darwin
books.summary: A distinguished amateur scientist lays out the evidence for the origin of species by means of natural selection.

books.title: Leviathan
books.author: Thomas Hobbes
books.summary: Hobbes explores a vision of the ideal state, in which people cede certain freedoms to a sovereign power in exchange for security and stability.

books.title: Poetry
books.author: Maria Lowell
books.summary: A collection of poetry by abolitionist Maria Lowell, published posthumously.

books.title: Those Barren Leaves
books.author: Aldous Huxley
books.summary: An aristocrat summons a group of “intelligentsia” to vacation in her Italian mansion.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.summary: A tragic scientist creates a monster in his laboratory.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Frank Belknap Long
books.summary: A collection of short fiction by Frank Belknap Long, ordered by date of original publication.

books.title: Festus
books.author: Philip James Bailey
books.summary: A man goes on a quest for knowledge, truth, and understanding in the face of the complexities of existence and spirituality.

books.title: With the Empress Dowager of China
books.author: Katharine A. Carl
books.summary: A female painter becomes the court artist of the Empress Dowager of China.
